resources.string: Limits screen time in selected apps by enforcing a cooldown period once your budget is reached.

To ensure FocusGuard functions reliably without interruption:

• Accessibility: Enable FocusGuard in Settings → Accessibility. If greyed out on Android 13+, open FocusGuard App Info → three dots (top-right) → Allow restricted settings.
• Battery: Set FocusGuard battery usage to "Unrestricted" in App Info.
• Autostart (Xiaomi / Poco / Oppo / Vivo): Allow Autostart and background activity in device settings.
• Xiaomi Pop-up Windows: In FocusGuard App Info → Other permissions → Enable "Display pop-up windows while running in the background".
